acceptance: The compact project rail shows a mark per recent local project, each the first grapheme of its name (else of its folder), uppercased; a mark enters its project in this window, and every mark keeps its place when the order of recent projects changes, only the active state moving; while a project is still opening the rail stays usable and the latest choice wins. Its create action opens one launcher offering creating a project, opening a folder and importing (with its source marks); a choice closes it and starts that flow.
